input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes exclusivity on us: we may not participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products (extended to "products substantially similar", i.e. an entire competitive category), and HDI holds the exclusive right to use our own "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer site. It runs for the whole term, and under Section 4.1 the term auto-renews annually, so the restriction can exceed 12 months indefinitely; there is no automatic exit for HDI service-level or delivery failures (Section 1.6 only gives a termination right if the Site is not live in 70 days, and Section 6.2 is a narrow closeout-merchandise carve-out). That fails the fallback on duration, scope and performance exit, so we redline to the fallback: exclusivity confined to Deerskin Products, capped at twelve months from the Effective Date, terminating automatically on any HDI service-level or delivery-date failure. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 benefits us and is untouched.

mappings.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.

proposal.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 exclusivity to Deerskin Products, cap it at 12 months, and add an automatic performance-based exit.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we take no exclusivity obligation; as a fallback we can accept exclusivity confined to Deerskin Products for no more than twelve months, ending automatically if HDI misses a service level or delivery date. We have made that change and left Section 6.2 and HDI's reciprocal covenant untouched.

ops.newText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, for a period of twelve (12) months from the Effective Date, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet. This Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically if HDI fails to meet any service level or any delivery date under this Agreement.
